chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, our intercession will not reach one who takes salat (prayer) lightly."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.بِالصَّلَاةِ: with respect to salat (prayer), the obligatory ritual prayer
key_terms.شَفَاعَتَنَا: our intercession; the intercessory role granted to the Ahl al-Bayt by Allah
key_terms.مُسْتَخِفًّا: one who treats something lightly, with disdain or neglect

ai.seo_question: Will the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt reach someone who neglects salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that divine intercession is not for those who treat salat (prayer) with neglect and disregard. The hadith emphasizes the gravity of salat and its central place in faith and accountability.
